roleTitle: I build AI agents that improve through data, testing, and human feedback.
paragraphs: I'm Pujan Bajracharya, an AI-focused engineer working across legal datasets, agentic workflows, prompt systems, RAG, eval pipelines, LLM distillation, data analytics, and human review.
I care about AI systems that can retrieve context, follow constraints, produce structured outputs, measure performance against ground truth, and improve through data-driven prompt optimization.

highlights.title: Legal Dataset Testing
highlights.desc: I create golden datasets, ground-truth labels, edge cases, and evaluation sets for legal AI workflows.

highlights.title: Prompt Standard Optimization
highlights.desc: I use eval results, failure patterns, and output scoring to improve prompts, schemas, and AI behavior.

highlights.title: Data + AI Insights
highlights.desc: I combine data analytics and AI output analysis to identify what works, what fails, and what should improve.

highlights.title: Product Engineering
highlights.desc: I turn AI insights into usable product workflows, review systems, dashboards, and human-in-the-loop pipelines.

callout: The goal is simple: make AI agents measurable, useful, and continuously improvable.
